name: Slim's Upholstery
brand_truth: From worn to wow, one stitch at a time: home, auto, marine, aircraft and church upholstery from Claridge Road.
buyer: Nassau homeowners with worn sofas/dining chairs, boat and car owners, church committees.

design.signature: Fabric studio: pick piece (sofa, dining chair, boat cushions, car seat, church pew), colour and weave; SVG recolours and stitches; sends WhatsApp quote

current_site_findings: Old BahamasLocal URL says 'may have closed down'.
pitch_line: Your Instagram shows beautiful work, but Google can't send anyone to it; this site lets a customer try colours on their sofa and WhatsApp you for a free quote in one minute.
notes: Ask Slim for 6-10 before/after photos from Instagram to drop into a before/after slider at launch. Confirm which number to lead with (814-5451 used, WhatsApp-enabled per FB post).
